stories.title: Anthropic prices its IPO at $83 per share, valuing the AI giant at $1.5 trillion
stories.take: Anthropic priced above range at $83, a $1.5 trillion valuation — investors shrugged off AI-bubble worries and the Nvidia shake-up.

stories.title: ‘Most extraordinary virtual world’: critics hail Grand Theft Auto VI as masterpiece
stories.take: The verdict is in after 13 years: critics call GTA VI a masterpiece, praising the two leads at the center of its Vice City return.

stories.title: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella explains why he asked 60K employees to quit
stories.take: Nadella says the 60,000 buyouts were about reshaping Microsoft for AI — voluntary exits instead of another mass layoff.

stories.title: Nvidia created a weird bit of intrigue by not filing a routine SEC report
stories.take: Nvidia skipped its routine 10-Q filing for weeks, adding fresh intrigue on top of Jensen Huang's exit.

stories.title: Waymo pulls driverless taxis from freeways across the US after California ban
stories.take: Waymo pulled driverless freeway rides nationwide, days after California banned its robotaxis from state freeways.

stories.title: Elon Musk claims ‘I’m not Maga’ and says he regrets vast sums to back Republicans
stories.take: Musk now says he feels 'pretty foolish' about his record $445 million in midterm spending — and insists he's not MAGA.

stories.title: Voyager 1 Beat the Odds and Is Still Working a Light-Day Away From Earth
stories.take: Voyager 1 is now a full light-day from Earth — the first human-made object that far out, still phoning home on 1970s tech.

stories.title: Brands booking creators to make their ads are pushing up $116B global influencer market
stories.take: Creator marketing is now a $116B market growing at double the pace of the rest of advertising, driven by brands hiring creators to make the ads themselves.

stories.title: Paid media now plays largest role in brand-funded creator growth: report
stories.take: Paid dollars behind creator content are now nearly half the category — the sponsored post is no longer the main event.

stories.title: MoviePass Explores a Sale, Pitching Streamers on a Theatrical Bundle
stories.take: MoviePass is shopping itself to streamers, pitching movie tickets as the bundle add-on streaming has been missing.

stories.title: Newsmax Sues Fox Over Roku Deal, Alleging Antitrust Violation
stories.take: Newsmax says Fox's Tubi and Roku Channel holdings give it about 71% of the free streaming TV market — and calls that an antitrust problem.

stories.title: Artists and creators are leaving Etsy in droves over its new AI policy
stories.take: Etsy's new AI policy is driving its core sellers out, with goodbye posts flooding social media.

stories.title: Maker’s Mark spotlights signature red wax top in visual refresh
stories.take: Maker's Mark is rebuilding its look around the red wax seal, as bourbon fights slowing sales and a glut of inventory.

stories.title: 👀 What the first month has revealed about all 30 teams
stories.take: One month in, every team has a defining storyline — ESPN takes stock of all 30, Lakers, Knicks, Spurs and Celtics included.

stories.title: Vanessa Bryant, widow of Kobe, reportedly teaming up with Pau Gasol to bid on WNBA's Sparks
stories.take: LA basketball royalty may own the Sparks: Vanessa Bryant and Pau Gasol are reportedly teaming up on a bid for the WNBA franchise.

stories.title: Randle sounds off after Bulls rout Nets: 'That was embarrassing'
stories.take: Julius Randle called the Nets' effort 'embarrassing' after a 30-point rout by the Bulls, questioning the team's pride.

stories.title: Reflective Lillard advised Giannis 'grass isn't always greener' before Heat trade
stories.take: Before Giannis left for Miami, Damian Lillard warned him the grass isn't always greener — a reflective Lillard tells the story on his return to Milwaukee.

stories.title: LeBron sues makers of AI sports-betting app 'Bron,' cites 'willful, bad-faith tactic'
stories.take: LeBron is suing the makers of an AI betting app called 'Bron' that used generated images of him in its marketing.

stories.title: Paul George embracing role as second option to Jayson Tatum: 'Not one of those guys that have to have an ego'
stories.take: Paul George says he's happy as Boston's second option behind Jayson Tatum after arriving in the Jaylen Brown trade.

stories.title: Sonny Gray returns to Twins on two-year, $55 million contract, per report
stories.take: Sonny Gray is a Twin again — two years, $55 million, reuniting with the club he pitched for in 2022-23.

stories.title: MLB commissioner Manfred cites fan support for salary cap as baseball heads towards lockout
stories.take: Manfred says owners won't budge on a salary cap and fans back a more equal game — baseball is on track for a Dec. 2 lockout that could threaten 2027.

stories.title: MLB expects $4B Angels sale to Kroenke to close in January
stories.take: The Angels' $4 billion sale to Kroenke Sports is expected to close in January.

stories.title: Mariners acquire 3B Garcia from Royals in six-player trade
stories.take: Seattle lands Gold Glove third baseman Maikel Garcia in a six-player deal; Kansas City gets starter Bryce Miller and takes on the risk.

stories.title: 2026-27 MLB free agent tracker: Tarik Skubal, Jazz Chisholm Jr., Randy Arozarena and more available players
stories.take: Tarik Skubal remains the prize of the winter — the free-agent tracker follows every meeting and move as his market heats up.

stories.title: Trump lands in China for trade talks and high-stakes summit with Xi and Putin
stories.take: Trump is in Shenzhen for a historic first trilateral with Xi and Putin at the APEC summit, with trade, AI and global conflicts on the table.

stories.title: Trump family and allies told to preserve records as Democrats prepare sweeping investigations
stories.take: Incoming Oversight chair Robert Garcia ordered a dozen Trump relatives and allies — sons, Kushner, Vance, Blanche — to preserve records ahead of sweeping investigations.

stories.title: Democrats nominate Jeffries for speaker, prep investigations into Trump's orbit
stories.take: Democrats formally nominated Hakeem Jeffries for Speaker while ramping up investigation plans for January.

stories.title: Democrats flipped 9 U.S. Senate seats — the most in almost 70 years
stories.take: Mary Peltola's Alaska win flipped a ninth Senate seat and locked a 56-44 Democratic majority — the biggest midterm Senate gain in nearly 70 years.

stories.title: Iran widens Gulf attacks by targeting U.S. air base in Kuwait and sites in Bahrain
stories.take: Iran widened its Gulf attacks to a U.S. air base in Kuwait and sites in Bahrain, citing U.S. drone surveillance and strikes on its communications towers.

stories.title: The law releasing the Epstein files passed one year ago. What do his victims say?
stories.take: A year after the Epstein Files Transparency Act forced millions of files out, victims say what the release has — and hasn't — delivered.

stories.title: Record-breaking rain lashes California’s Bay area as ‘atmospheric river’ arrives
stories.take: Record rain hit downtown San Francisco with flooding and outages across the Bay Area; the atmospheric river now moves into Southern California.

stories.title: L.A. County issues evacuation warnings as storm nears; snow, flooding expected
stories.take: LA County issued evacuation warnings ahead of the season's first big atmospheric river — rain, wind, high surf and mountain snow into Thursday.

stories.title: Becerra faces a $2 billion budget deficit as potential AI bust looms
stories.take: The Legislative Analyst warns California banked billions on the AI stock boom — a bust could mean a $2B deficit now and $35B a year by 2028-29.

stories.title: Newsom touts an AI kill switch to halt dangerous OpenAI, Anthropic releases
stories.take: Newsom took an AI safety plan to Washington, including a kill switch for dangerous model releases from OpenAI and Anthropic.

stories.title: Police price tag for L.A.'s '28 Summer Olympics could hit $4 billion, LAPD chief says
stories.take: Policing the 2028 LA Olympics could cost $3-4 billion across LAPD, the Sheriff's Department and other agencies, the chief says.

stories.title: Santa Ana suspends its Flock license plate reader camera system
stories.take: Santa Ana is switching off four dozen Flock license plate readers as privacy concerns spread across Southern California cities.

The answer: testers say GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol were tuned for cost-efficiency over quality — writing so concise it is hard to follow, coding that stops too early and regressed on the coding-agent index, and a rigid house style; Matt Schumer called them 'essentially unusable' and Every's 30-person team would not switch • Defenders counter that Astra runs tasks 35% cheaper ($4 vs $6.24) and shines at computer use — and that OpenAI changed the models days before launch without retesting • Also: Nvidia's board told Jensen Huang it will not reinstate him despite his public offer to return, even as Nvidia posted 103% revenue growth and raised Q4 guidance to $130B • The week's outage cascade (Microsoft, FAA, NSA) looks like a Y2K-style upgrade surge, not a cyberattack
stories.title: Why the AI Kids Hate Astra 6.2

stories.take: Anthropic's IPO tomorrow (~$1.5-1.6T valuation) tests the AI trade — and shows how IPOs changed: companies now grow up privately first (Amazon listed at 3 years old, SpaceX at 24), leaving ~100 IPOs a year vs ~300 in the '80s-'90s and half as many public companies • Fed minutes: holding rates was a 'close call,' with a December hike likely and officials worried about AI's price effects • Inside the 'truck recession': an LA dealer's sales fell from dozens of trucks a month to 2-3 as final-mile delivery ate traditional trucking • Health costs climb again — ACA silver plans +13% after +25% last year, partly driven by AI scribes capturing more billable diagnoses
stories.title: IPOs grow and grow

stories.take: Mary Peltola flipped Alaska with a hyper-local 'fish, family, freedom' campaign, clearing 50% outright — the first Alaska Native in the Senate — and padding the Democratic majority ahead of a rough 2028 GOP map • House Democrats nominated Hakeem Jeffries for Speaker 251-11; divisions remain over Medicare steps and Israel, and Schumer's Senate leadership vote looks fraught • Mailbag verdicts: the debt gets fixed only in absolute crisis, direct candidate donations beat outside-group money, and lowering the filibuster to 55 goes nowhere because abolitionists say it undercuts majority rule
stories.title: Dems win another Senate seat

stories.take: Chiquita Canyon's underground burn (since ~2023, now ~90 acres at up to 300°F) may take 20 years to burn out — Monday a drilling crew hit a gas pocket and a trash geyser scattered debris across the Santa Clarita Valley, driving self-evacuations • AG Bonta has sued owner Waste Connections; residents got a 3-night hotel offer they call inadequate, and the state fine-and-fund law does not start until Jan. 1 • Courtroom artist Isabelle Brocherman's 'You Have the Body' show covers Trump's trials and ICE courts — an agent's rubber bullet pierced her drawing board in Minneapolis • GTA VI at midnight: reviewers say the Jason-Lucia love story sets it apart, with ~$2B in sales expected in 3 days
stories.title: Garbage out: Avalanches of 'trash juice' threaten Chiquita Canyon

stories.take: How to avoid hospice fraud: guard your Medicare number like a credit card PIN — scammers enroll people without providing care and bill per day; report suspected fraud to 1-800-Medicare • Evacuation warnings are in effect from 6 p.m. for Palisades, Eaton and other burn scars, with the strongest rain mid-morning tomorrow and debris-flow risk • LA County hospice agencies exploded from ~100 in 2010 to 2,000+ at peak and still top 1,100, with fraud warning signs unchanged despite crackdowns • UC students protested restoring SAT/ACT admissions at the Regents; no action taken
stories.title: Burn scar areas under evac warnings ahead of major storm, How to avoid hospice care fraud, UC students pushback on SAT/ACT scores for admissions — Afternoon Edition

stories.take: The Nvidia scandal revived Washington's China hawks — Bannon, Lighthizer, Sens. Ricketts, Banks and Cotton — and momentum for tighter chip export controls, even as Trump publicly backs a friendlier line in China • Anthropic priced its IPO at $83, above range, listing tomorrow; the week's U.S. outages were upgrade failures, not a hack, per DNI Clayton • The U.S. lost measles elimination status: ~6,000 cases and 10 deaths this year, and winning it back could take five years of zero cases plus proactive vaccination • A Van Gogh heads to auction tonight expected to break the artist's $117M record, after a last-minute settlement over a claimed Nazi-era forced sale
stories.title: China Hawks Get Their Way in Washington After Nvidia Scandal
